text: mcp-tool-list (at 2.1.19, unchanged in this window) says the default grouping is 'by the `srv-*` tag', and the dependencies section (dktzfo4k) says grouping goes through two mirror tags `mNN` and `srv-{server}`. The code (since 0.2.33, grouping.ts `groupByServer`) groups by the `server` FIELD and deliberately dropped the `srv-{server}` mirror tag (no tag policing in the detail either). The visible result is the same — one group per server, the server name as the heading — so the window's change (groups laid out by the catalog's `GroupedEntityList`) is built on the field grouping, not switched back to tags. Assumed: the field grouping stands; the spec should say 'grouped by the `server` field' and drop the `srv-*` mirror-tag wording, or say otherwise.
assumption: ASSUMPTION:dev-1904 — default grouping by the `server` field, not by a `srv-*` tag
